question_en: What barcode pattern does the default barcode nomenclature use for location barcodes?
question_ru: Какой шаблон штрихкода используется для штрихкодов локаций в стандартной номенклатуре?
expected_answer: Location barcodes use the pattern 414 (rule 'Location barcodes', encoding Any).
evidence: location barcodes; type: location; encoding: any; barcode pattern: 414

question_en: Which GS1 application identifier is used for batch or lot numbers?
question_ru: Какой идентификатор применения (AI) GS1 используется для номера партии (лота)?
expected_answer: AI 10 ('Batch or lot number'), pattern (10) followed by up to 20 alphanumeric characters; it fills the Lot field.
evidence: batch or lot number; type: lot; barcode pattern: (10)
rule name: batch or lot number; a.i.: 10

question_en: What is the default delay between two scans in the Odoo Barcode app and why does it exist?
question_ru: Какая по умолчанию задержка между сканированиями в приложении Barcode и зачем она нужна?
expected_answer: 100 milliseconds, to prevent accidental double scanning.
evidence: default 100-millisecond delay between scans

question_en: Which RFID tag encoding scheme is supported by Odoo?
question_ru: Какая схема кодирования RFID-меток поддерживается в Odoo?
expected_answer: Only SGTIN-96; serial numbers in the EPC must be numeric and only UHF tags are supported.
evidence: sgtin-96 is the only supported encoding scheme

question_en: Which split methods can be chosen for a landed cost product?
question_ru: Какие методы распределения можно выбрать для продукта дополнительных расходов (landed cost)?
expected_answer: Equal, By Quantity, By Current Cost, By Weight and By Volume.
evidence: by current cost: splits the cost according to the cost of each product unit
by volume: splits the cost according to the volume

question_en: How many characters can a warehouse short name have?
question_ru: Сколько символов может быть в коротком имени склада?
expected_answer: At most five characters; the default warehouse short name is WH.
evidence: maximum five characters

question_en: What is the default scheduled date of an inventory count?
question_ru: Какая дата инвентаризации запланирована по умолчанию?
expected_answer: The 31st of December of the current year; it can be changed with the Annual Inventory Day and Month setting.
evidence: 31st of december of the current year
annual inventory day and month

question_en: Which shipping connector can be used in India?
question_ru: Какой коннектор доставки можно использовать в Индии?
expected_answer: Shiprocket.
evidence: carrier: shiprocket; region availability: india

question_en: How often does the scheduler that triggers automatic reordering rules run by default?
question_ru: Как часто по умолчанию запускается планировщик, который срабатывает для автоматических правил пополнения?
expected_answer: Once a day; it can be run manually with Inventory > Operations > Run Scheduler in developer mode.
evidence: the scheduler is set to run once a day
answer_keywords: once a day|once per day|daily|раз в день|ежедневно|раз в сутки

question_en: What is the default label type of a shipping method?
question_ru: Какой тип этикетки доставки используется по умолчанию?
expected_answer: Paper Letter.
evidence: the default label type is paper letter

question_en: When does text get cut off on standard ZPL labels printed by Odoo?
question_ru: Когда текст обрезается на стандартных ZPL-этикетках, которые печатает Odoo?
expected_answer: When a line exceeds fifty-five characters; the margin can be adjusted in the ZPL code.
evidence: exceeds fifty-five characters

question_en: Which label printer model does Odoo recommend for shipping labels?
question_ru: Какой принтер этикеток Odoo рекомендует для печати этикеток доставки?
expected_answer: The Zebra ZD411, because Odoo supports the ZPL protocol.
evidence: odoo recommends the zebra zd411

question_en: How can I hide the expected quantity from workers during a barcode inventory count?
question_ru: Как скрыть ожидаемое количество от сотрудников во время инвентаризации через Barcode?
expected_answer: Inventory > Configuration > Settings, Barcode section: clear the Show Quantity to Count checkbox and save.
evidence: clear the show quantity to count checkbox

question_en: How do I enable wave transfers?
question_ru: Как включить волновые перемещения (wave transfers)?
expected_answer: Inventory > Configuration > Settings: in Operations tick Batch, Wave & Cluster Transfers; in Warehouse enable Storage Locations and Multi-Step Routes; save.
evidence: tick the batch, wave & cluster transfers checkbox

question_en: How do I make the Replenish on Order (MTO) route available on products?
question_ru: Как сделать маршрут Replenish on Order (MTO) доступным для товаров?
expected_answer: Enable Multi-Step Routes, then Inventory > Configuration > Routes, use the Archived filter, select Replenish on Order (MTO) and Actions > Unarchive. Then tick it on the product together with Buy or Manufacture.
evidence: by default, odoo sets the mto (make to order) route as archived
from the drop-down menu, select unarchive

question_en: How can I revert an inventory adjustment that was applied by mistake?
question_ru: Как отменить ошибочно применённую корректировку остатков?
expected_answer: Inventory > Reporting > Moves History, select the line, Actions > Revert Inventory Adjustment; a new line marked [reverted] is added.
evidence: click revert inventory adjustment

question_en: How do I schedule a location to be counted every 30 days?
question_ru: Как настроить, чтобы локация пересчитывалась каждые 30 дней?
expected_answer: Enable Storage Locations, open the location (Inventory > Configuration > Locations) and set Inventory Frequency to 30 in the Cyclic Counting section.
evidence: should have the inventory frequency value set to 30
set the inventory frequency field to the desired interval

question_en: Odoo does not recognize barcodes scanned with a Zebra TC21 scanner. What setting should I check?
question_ru: Odoo не распознаёт штрихкоды со сканера Zebra TC21. Какую настройку проверить?
expected_answer: In the DataWedge profile enable keystroke output and, in Key event options, check Send Characters as Events.
evidence: ensure the send characters as events option is checked

question_en: How do I configure a 0/0/1 reordering rule?
question_ru: Как настроить правило пополнения 0/0/1?
expected_answer: From the product's Reordering Rules smart button click New, choose the location and route (e.g. Buy), leave Min and Max at 0.00 and set To Order to 1.00.
evidence: in the min field and max field, leave the values set to 0.00

question_en: With two-step delivery, how can the carrier label be printed when the picking is validated instead of the delivery?
question_ru: При двухшаговой отгрузке как печатать этикетку перевозчика при подтверждении комплектации, а не доставки?
expected_answer: Inventory > Configuration > Operations Types, open the Pick operation and tick the Print Label checkbox.
evidence: tick the print label checkbox

question_en: How do I allow new lot numbers to be created on a specific operation type?
question_ru: Как разрешить создание новых номеров партий для определённого типа операции?
expected_answer: Open the operation type (Inventory > Configuration > Operations Types) and, in the Lots/Serial Numbers section, tick Create New (Use Existing ones allows selecting existing numbers).
evidence: tick the create new checkbox to enable new lot numbers
create new: select this checkbox to specify that lots and serial numbers can be created

question_en: How do I set up $20 flat-rate shipping that becomes free above $100?
question_ru: Как настроить фиксированную доставку за $20, бесплатную при заказе от $100?
expected_answer: Inventory > Configuration > Delivery Methods > New: Provider Fixed Price, Fixed Price 20, tick Free if order amount is above and enter 100, set a Delivery Product.
evidence: to set up $20 flat-rate shipping that becomes free if the customer spends over $100
answer_keywords: free if order amount is above

question_en: How can I cancel a shipping request that was already sent to the carrier?
question_ru: Как отменить запрос на доставку, который уже отправлен перевозчику?
expected_answer: After validation, click the Cancel button next to Carrier Tracking Ref; then the carrier can be changed and Send to shipper creates a new label.
evidence: click on the cancel button next to the carrier tracking ref

question_en: Which removal strategies exist in Odoo and which settings must be enabled for each?
question_ru: Какие стратегии отбора (removal strategies) есть в Odoo и какие настройки нужны для каждой?
expected_answer: FIFO and LIFO need Lots & Serial Numbers; FEFO needs Lots & Serial Numbers and Expiration Dates; Closest Location needs Storage Locations and Multi-Step Routes; Least Packages needs Packages.
evidence: required features; fifo: lots & serial numbers
the packages feature must be enabled to use this strategy

question_en: What is the difference between the Replenish on Order (MTO) route and a 0/0/1 reordering rule?
question_ru: Чем отличается маршрут Replenish on Order (MTO) от правила пополнения 0/0/1?
expected_answer: Both replenish when a sales order is confirmed, but MTO reserves the replenished product for that SO and links the PO/MO with a smart button; the 0/0/1 rule does not reserve the product and does not link the order.
evidence: the main difference between the two methods
odoo automatically links the sales order to the po

question_en: Which internal locations are used by two-step and three-step receipts and deliveries?
question_ru: Какие внутренние локации используются при двух- и трёхшаговой приёмке и отгрузке?
expected_answer: WH/Input for 2- and 3-step receipts, WH/Quality Control for 3-step receipts, WH/Packing Zone for 3-step deliveries and WH/Output for 2- and 3-step deliveries, besides WH/Stock.
evidence: <wh>/quality control: where received products are checked
creates two new internal locations: input (wh/input), and quality control
creates two new internal locations: a packing zone (wh/packing zone), and output

question_en: How do batch picking, cluster picking and wave transfers differ?
question_ru: Чем отличаются batch picking, cluster picking и wave transfers?
expected_answer: Batch: one picker handles several whole orders and sorts them afterwards at the output location. Cluster: items are sorted into a package per order during picking. Wave: transfers are split (e.g. by product or location) and the parts are grouped into a batch.
evidence: batch picking enables a single picker to handle multiple orders at once
cluster picking sorts items directly into designated bins
wave transfers are batch transfers with an extra step

question_en: Which valuation features require the product category to use AVCO or FIFO costing?
question_ru: Для каких функций оценки запасов категория товара должна использовать метод AVCO или FIFO?
expected_answer: Landed costs on vendor bills and valuation by lots/serial numbers both require a costing method of AVCO or FIFO (Standard Price is not enough).
evidence: costing method of either avco (average costing) or fifo
costing method is set to first in first out (fifo) or average cost (avco)

question_en: What reservation methods are available for delivery orders and how do they differ?
question_ru: Какие методы резервирования доступны для заказов на доставку и чем они отличаются?
expected_answer: At Confirmation reserves when the order is confirmed if stock exists; Manually requires Check Availability; Before scheduled date reserves a set number of days before the scheduled date (separate value for starred transfers). Set per operation type.
evidence: there are three different reservation methods in odoo
the manually reservation method does not reserve products automatically

question_en: What is the difference between visibility days and horizon days in replenishment?
question_ru: В чём разница между visibility days и horizon days при пополнении?
expected_answer: Visibility days only add future demand when a replenishment is already triggered on the forecasted date; horizon days push the forecasted date forward so manual rules trigger as soon as stock falls below the minimum within that window.
evidence: visibility days: only checks future demand if a replenishment would have been triggered today
horizon days determine how many days ahead odoo checks

question_en: How is the forecasted quantity of a product calculated?
question_ru: Как рассчитывается прогнозируемое количество товара?
expected_answer: Forecasted = on hand + incoming - outgoing; it is shown on the product's Forecasted smart button / forecasted report and only exists for tracked products.
evidence: by adding the on hand and incoming quantity, and subtracting the outgoing quantity
number of units expected to be available in inventory after all orders are taken into account

question_en: Our vendor's lot barcodes are often scratched when they arrive and then we cannot validate the receipt. What should we change?
question_ru: Штрихкоды партий от поставщика часто приходят поцарапанными, и мы не можем подтвердить приёмку. Что изменить?
expected_answer: Make lot/serial number scanning optional on the operation type, so a damaged barcode does not block validation.
evidence: it is a good practice to set serial number or lot scanning to optional

question_en: A location can hold 10 units but 12 units arrive. Will Odoo send the extra units to another location?
question_ru: Локация вмещает 10 единиц, а пришло 12. Отправит ли Odoo лишние единицы в другую локацию?
expected_answer: No. Odoo does not split quantities across storage locations; all 12 units are assigned to the first recommended location.
evidence: odoo does not automatically split quantities across multiple storage locations

question_en: A product is sold in packs of 12, a customer orders two packs and we have 22 units. How many units are reserved if only full packs may be reserved?
question_ru: Товар продаётся упаковками по 12, клиент заказал две упаковки, на складе 22 единицы. Сколько единиц зарезервируется, если разрешены только полные упаковки?
expected_answer: 12 units with Reserve Only Full Packagings (22 with Reserve Partial Packagings).
evidence: only twelve units are reserved for the order

question_en: Eggs arrive on January 1st; their expiration date is 30 days after receipt and the removal date is 15 days before expiration. When must they be removed from stock?
question_ru: Яйца поступили 1 января; срок годности 30 дней после поступления, дата изъятия за 15 дней до истечения. Когда их нужно убрать со склада?
expected_answer: January 16th (expiration January 31st minus 15 days).
evidence: the removal date is january 16th

question_en: We keep a supplier's goods in our warehouse but they still belong to the supplier. How do we receive them so they do not affect our valuation?
question_ru: Мы храним товары поставщика, но они остаются его собственностью. Как их принимать, чтобы они не влияли на нашу оценку запасов?
expected_answer: Use consignment: enable it, and on the receipt set Receive From and Assign Owner to the same vendor; consigned stock is not in the stock valuation.
evidence: the receive from and assign owner fields must match
these products are not reflected in the stock valuation report

question_en: Shipping is $20 for orders with five or fewer products, the margin on rate is 10% and the additional margin is $9. How much does a customer pay for shipping a 3-product order?
question_ru: Доставка стоит $20 для заказов до пяти товаров, наценка на тариф 10%, дополнительная наценка $9. Сколько клиент заплатит за доставку заказа из 3 товаров?
evidence: the delivery cost is $31

question_en: Two customers wait for the same incoming purchase and one of them is urgent. How can I decide which order gets the received units?
question_ru: Два клиента ждут один и тот же входящий закуп, один из них срочный. Как решить, какому заказу достанутся поступившие единицы?
expected_answer: Enable Reception Report and use the Allocations button on the receipt to assign units of the PO to specific sales orders.
evidence: allocate incoming stock from purchase orders (pos) to one or more sales orders
an allocations smart button appears

question_en: Some received products seem to stay in WH/Input and are never put away. How can I find them?
question_ru: Часть принятых товаров, похоже, застряла в WH/Input и так и не размещена. Как их найти?
expected_answer: Use the stranded inventory report: Inventory > Reporting > Locations and search the location (e.g. WH/Input).
evidence: stranded inventory report
searching input in location shows a list of products at a wh/input location

question_ru: Как настроить начисление зарплаты для сотрудников склада?

question_ru: Какая столица Франции?

question_ru: Как настроить оповещения датчиков температуры для холодильных локаций?

question_ru: Какие новые функции склада появились в Odoo 19?
